decisions.reason: The general requirement for sensible and credible numbers does not change the established government-facing narrative, projection status, or investment-case message.
The source reinforces model integrity but does not change how assumptions must be annotated or which materials provide their reference basis.
Credibility of numerical results is distinct from the candidate's presentation-quality requirement and does not alter its current attributes or scope.
The source establishes a general integrity standard but supplies no change to the capex estimate, midpoint basis, provisional status, or shared-cost treatment.
The request for sensible and credible figures does not modify the availability-payment targets, sizing basis, or required viability conclusion.
No financing parameter or structural choice is changed by the general model-integrity instruction.
The source does not revise the selected operating-cost range, its source basis, or the exclusion of the Appendix figure.
The general credibility instruction does not change the authoritative Business Case site list.
